planets.name: WASP-72 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Diya with a 2.22-day year, found in 2012.

text.card: WASP-72 b was found in 2012 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Diya. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2012, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 2.21674331, pl_radj 1.29, pl_bmassj 2.3

quotes.title: WASP-72
quotes.card: It is orbited by a planet, WASP-72b.
quotes.introduction: The age of WASP-72 is younger than the Sun at 3.55±0.82 billion years.
